simpleDetails.whatIsIt: This template records vaccination against Erysipelothrix rhusiopathiae infection. The condition is relevant to herd health and may affect production, respiratory health, or reproduction depending on the pathogen and farm setting.
simpleDetails.whyGiven: It may be included in a veterinarian-led preventive-care plan to reduce disease risk or impact when vaccination is appropriate. The correct product, eligibility, timing, and follow-up should always be confirmed with a veterinarian and local guidance. Confirm the product, suitability, timing, and next due date with a veterinarian.
benefits: May reduce disease and production losses.
